description: Change the application's colour management (Edit > Color Settings): load a preset or a .csf settings file, turn colour management on or off, set the RGB and CMYK working spaces and policies, the profile mismatch and missing profile prompts, the engine, intent and black point compensation, accurate Lab spots, and the Appearance of Black preferences

accurateLabSpots.description: Use Lab values to display and convert spot colours (Accurate LAB Spots)

cmykPolicy.description: Color Management Policies > CMYK: off, preserve embedded profiles, convert to working space, or (CMYK) preserve numbers

cmykWorkingSpace.description: Working Spaces > CMYK: a profile name from get_color_settings (lists.cmykWorkingSpaces)

engine.description: Conversion Options > Engine: a name from get_color_settings (lists.engines)

preset.description: Settings: a colour settings preset name from get_color_settings (lists.presets), applied before the other options

presetFile.description: Load: path of a colour settings (.csf) file, applied before the other options

rgbPolicy.description: Color Management Policies > RGB: off, preserve embedded profiles, convert to working space, or (CMYK) preserve numbers

rgbWorkingSpace.description: Working Spaces > RGB: a profile name from get_color_settings (lists.rgbWorkingSpaces)

richBlackOnExport.description: Appearance of Black > Printing/Exporting: true = Output All Blacks as Rich Black, false = Output All Blacks Accurately

richBlackOnScreen.description: Appearance of Black > On Screen: true = Display All Blacks as Rich Black, false = Display All Blacks Accurately

name: set_color_settings
title: Set Color Settings
